1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) virus that is distinct from the bovine viral diarrhea virus type la (BVDV-la), __and__ a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the composition does not include both BVDV-la and BVDV-lb in a co-administered live form.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein the modified, live viruses are not co-administered with a modified, live BVDV-lb.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen that is not derived from BVDV-lb. 

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is __not derived from BVDV-lb__ and is inactivated.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen that is distinct from BVDV-lb.
